title: Retail delivery: “ready for pick-up”
summary: Here’s a gripe that many retail workers have: a customer arriving to collect an in-store pick-up order that isn’t ready. Getcho supports three mechanisms for indicating order readiness, and sends drivers at precisely the moment an order is ready.
body_markdown:
FAQ


## Questions, answered


Can't find what you need? Send us a delivery and we'll quote it, or email the team.


[Get a quote](https://getcho.app/get-a-quote/)sales@getcho.app


What is Getcho?


Getcho ("get-cho") runs shipping and delivery for brands and 3PLs at every location. Any store or warehouse can fulfill: Getcho prices each order across carriers and local couriers, dispatches it through partners or your own drivers, and watches it to the door. Checkout offers live rates, same-day delivery and pickup. Stock moves between locations. Failed deliveries are caught and claimed.


Can my stores ship online orders?


Yes. Getcho lets any location fulfill, not only a central warehouse. An order can ship from the store holding stock — with a parcel label for standard shipping, or with a local delivery partner when the customer is nearby.


Does Getcho show live shipping rates at checkout?


Yes, on Shopify. Live rates replace flat shipping fees at checkout, with box and weight logic so the quote matches what ships. Getcho assigns the cheapest available carrier that meets each order, and nearby customers can also choose same-day delivery or pickup.


How does Getcho scale with my business?


Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.


What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?


Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.


What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?


We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.


Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?


Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable. Branded tracking is included on every plan.


Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?


Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.


Show all 20 questions Can I customize delivery zones and hours?


Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.


Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?


Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.


What areas does Getcho service?


Getcho dispatches in all 50 US states. Same-day local delivery runs wherever our courier partners operate, and parcel and freight go anywhere in the US. In Canada, Getcho dispatches local delivery. Which options you can offer depends on where your locations are.


What can my business send with Getcho?


Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates and freight—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.


Can I track my delivery?


Yes. All deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs and proof-of-delivery photos. A custom branded tracking link is included on every plan, and premium plans also let multiple recipients receive updates and notifications on orders.


What types of notifications do my customers receive?


Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.


What happens if a delivery goes wrong?


We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.


Can Getcho handle returns?


Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.


Does Getcho support round trips?


Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.


Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?


Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.


Can I schedule a delivery in advance?


Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.


How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?


Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins the job. Most orders are completed within hours. We also support scheduled, next-day, and recurring deliveries.
